{{recipe}}

This kebab is prepared by marinating meat overnight and grilling it over an open fire. It is usually served with polo (white rice) or [[Cookbook:Naan|naan]].

==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
* [[Cookbook:Garlic|Garlic]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Saffron|saffron]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] [[Cookbook:Lamb|lamb]], cut into 1 x 5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] pieces

==Procedure==

# Combine the olive oil, onions, garlic, saffron, salt, and pepper to make the marinade.
# Toss the lamb pieces with the marinade. Cover, and [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]] overnight in the refrigerator.
# Thread the lamb onto metal [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewers]].
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] the lamb with the marinade. [[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] for 5–10 minutes on each side over an open fire.
